title: Tidying Up
hook: 房间乱得下不去脚，全家人比赛谁先收拾好，收着收着又玩起了恐龙。

cells.a: They are in their bedroom playing with their toys.
She is sitting down and reading her book.
She asked what on earth is going on upstairs.
cells.cn: 她问楼上到底在闹什么。

cells.a: They can play again when they have tidied up.
cells.cn: 他们收拾好了才能再玩。

cells.q: What game did they decide to play?
cells.a: They decided to see who can tidy up first.
cells.cn: 他们决定比一比谁先收拾完。

cells.q: What toy did Daddy Pig find?
cells.a: He found a toy tyrannosaurus rex in the mess.
cells.cn: 他在乱堆里发现一只霸王龙玩具。

cells.a: She said she and Mummy are going to win.
cells.cn: 她说她和妈妈一定会赢。

cells.a: Everyone wins, because the room is tidy at last.
cells.cn: 大家都赢了，因为房间终于收拾干净了。

cells.q: What happened to the room at the end?
cells.a: They played again, so the room is untidy again.
cells.cn: 他们又玩起来，房间又乱了。
